description: Possible Flood Water Saturated (5 event data sets, United Nations Satellite Centre, on HDX) is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). This map illustrates satellite detected possible flood water & saturated soil over Wad Madani, in Al Jazeera State, extracted from Radarsat-2 imagery (12 m) acquired on 18 August 2016. According to satellite derived analysis some areas within Al Jazeera State seem to be flooded. Coverage: Sudan. The portal lists 5 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2025-11-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
